entities.title: .dev folder
entities.summary: The folder beside a folder's code that holds its views and knowledge files, one JSON file per kind.

entities.title: View
entities.summary: A file that describes a folder's architecture or behavior: one of the four diagrams or five behavior views.

entities.title: Diagram
entities.summary: A component, deployment, class or state view, always drawn.

entities.title: Behavior view
entities.summary: A use case, user journey, capability, feature or operation view; the first two are drawn, the rest written out.

entities.title: Knowledge file
entities.summary: A file of one of the catalogue's twenty-five kinds (vision, backlog, decisions and the rest), shown as cards under the Knowledge tab.

entities.title: Kind
entities.summary: What a file is: component, feature, backlog and so on. Each view kind has its own colour and icon; all knowledge kinds share one.

entities.title: Record
entities.summary: One entry in a knowledge file, shown as a card. The schemas call it an entity.

entities.title: Part
entities.summary: One thing in a drawing: a component, node, artifact, type, state, step, alternative or stage.

entities.title: Plate
entities.summary: A part drawn as a rounded box with its icon on a tinted square, its name and a line under it.

entities.title: Cluster
entities.summary: A part that holds other parts, drawn as a frame with a header band: a component that contains others, or a host with what it runs.

entities.title: Badge
entities.summary: The round mark at a part's corner that says it opens another folder.

entities.title: Pip
entities.summary: A small kind icon after a folder's name in the tree or on a chip, with a count when there is more than one.

entities.title: Tab
entities.summary: One kind of view in a folder; the folder shows one at a time.

entities.title: Inspector
entities.summary: The panel at the right that holds everything a view says about the selected part.

entities.title: Drill
entities.summary: Opening the folder a badged part stands for, by clicking it; the part grows into the page as it opens.

entities.title: Related view
entities.summary: A view that another view names as related, with why; the way between a feature and its operations and capability.

entities.title: Waiting
entities.summary: The list of every open decision and unresolved blocker in a repository, and the link to it above the tree.

entities.title: Scope
entities.summary: What a token is for: every repository on a host, everything under an owner or group, or one repository.

entities.title: Evidence
entities.summary: How far a record has been checked: source-verified, documented or proposed. Shown as a badge.

entities.title: Status line
entities.summary: The one line under the bar that says what the page is doing or what went wrong.

entities.title: Ref
entities.summary: The branch, tag or commit being read, shown as a pill after the repository's name.
